expected.raw_text: ML or software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on work building and evaluating ML systems

parsed.notes: In 'At least five years of ML or software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on work building and evaluating ML systems', ML is clearly required from the second clause, and software engineering is also required independently in the third bullet ('reliable production software development'). PyTorch and Transformers in 'PyTorch, Transformers or comparable ML libraries' would share an alternative_group if requested in the schema. Flagged 'language-model training' -> llms, 'post-training' -> fine-tuning, 'recommendation metrics' -> recommender-systems, and 'online experimentation' -> a-b-testing as uncertain due to slight phrasing differences from canonical taxonomy aliases.
